summary_1line: Rama, Sita, and Lakshmana arrive at Panchavati; Lakshmana builds a hermitage by the Godavari where they begin their forest dwelling peacefully.

image_candidates.scene_text: Rama stands beside Sita and Lakshmana overlooking the lotus-filled Godavari, pointing to a shaded clearing where their hermitage will be built.
Lakshmana constructs a bamboo-and-branch hut in the forest of Panchavati while deer wander nearby and Sita watches beneath flowering trees.
Rama warmly embraces Lakshmana before the newly built thatched hut as Sita stands nearby in the peaceful forest clearing.
